answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 30744 Country: India Title: When Grand-mother died, Q1) elders in my home, laid the body, as legs facing Qibla, is it right way? Q2) Tell me a book ( in English / Urdu), which lay a body after death, to perform ghusl for the body and procedure to kafan it according Hanafi? Question: when Grand-mother died, Q1) elders in my home, laid the body, as legs facing Qibla, is it right way? Q2) Tell me a book ( in English / Urdu), which lay a body after death, to perform ghusl for the body and procedure to kafan it according Hanafi? Answer ID: 30744 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 330/297/B=1432) This process is also lawful. But it is better to, as soon as the soul leaves the body, turn the head towards north and the leg towards south. You should study Bahishti Zewar to know the details of Shariah rulings. It is a remarkable book in Urdu. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
